result.document_summary: A portion of San Diego Municipal Code Chapter 3, Article 3, Division 37 covering alarm system permits, false alarms, fines, and revocation, which is unrelated to rental housing rules despite the source URL referencing an algorithmic rent-setting division.
result.notes: This part contains only alarm system permit regulations (permit applications, false alarm fines, revocation, apartment alarm responsibility). None of it falls within the six in-scope rental housing categories. The URL slug mentions a division on prohibiting algorithmic rent price-fixing, but no text of that rule appears in this part, so nothing is extracted. Section 33.3713 concerns who obtains alarm permits in apartment buildings, which is not a rent, eviction, deposit, screening-fee, screening-restriction, or algorithmic rent-setting rule.
